name: Road
description: Normal movement. No protection.

name: Plains
description: Normal movement. No protection.

name: Forest
description: Costs 2 movement; ranged damage reduced by 1.

name: Hills
description: Costs 2 movement; all damage reduced by 1.

name: Water
description: Impassable to land units.

name: Bridge
description: A crossing over water. Normal movement; no protection.

name: Shallow water
description: Costs 3 movement for soldiers and commanders, 2 for archers and scouts. Units here take 1 extra damage.

name: Village
description: +2 gold per turn. Heals a friendly occupant by 4 HP.

name: Keep
description: Your commander can recruit into adjacent empty hexes. Blocks ranged attacks through the tile.

name: Marsh
description: Mud slows land units and exposes them to 1 extra damage. Merfolk move easily here and take 1 less damage.

name: Ruins
description: Broken walls reduce ranged damage by 1 without blocking shots through the tile. Some campaign ruins contain binding stones; their objectives specify who can seal them.

name: Fort
description: Earthworks reduce all incoming damage by 1. Capture by entering; forts provide no income or healing.

name: Sacred grove
description: Trees reduce ranged damage by 1 and block shots through the tile. An owned grove heals its friendly occupant by 4 HP, but provides no income.

name: Ferry landing
description: A jetty on the riverbank. Normal movement; no protection.

name: Moored ferry
description: A boat moored beside a riverbank jetty. Normal movement; no protection. Boarding does not move units across the river.

name: House
description: A single home. Normal movement; no protection, income or healing.

name: Mountains
description: A sheer mountain ridge, impassable to land units. Blocks ranged attacks through the tile.

name: Quarry cave
description: A sheltered entrance at the foot of a mountain. Costs 2 movement; no protection. The mountain blocks ranged attacks through the tile. Scenario objectives specify what can be found inside.

name: Burned village
description: Charred homes on open ground. No income, healing or protection.

name: Road sign
description: A wooden waymarker beside the road. Normal movement; no protection.

name: Castle courtyard
description: Paved fortifications. Normal movement; all incoming damage reduced by 1. No income, healing or recruitment.

name: Castle gate
description: Paved fortifications. Normal movement; all incoming damage reduced by 1. No income, healing or recruitment.

name: Bell keep
description: An enclosed bell-tower courtyard. Normal movement; all incoming damage reduced by 1. No income, healing or recruitment.

name: Hill monastery
description: A hilltop sanctuary. Costs 1 movement and shelters against ranged attacks. Scenario rituals use this site.

name: Church
description: A quiet church. Normal movement; no protection. Scenario discoveries may leave equipment here.

name: Burial ground
description: Old burial stones. Normal movement; no protection.

name: Ritual mark
description: A charged ritual mark. Captives still standing here can be consumed by the bell.

name: Spent ritual mark
description: The ritual has burned out. It cannot feed the bell again.
